description: Lebanese commercial bank (founded 1949), majority-owned subsidiary of Fransabank S.A.L., listed on the Beirut Stock Exchange (still trading in 2026 per Investing.com pricing data). Retail and corporate banking. Chairman and General Manager: Nadim Kassar (also Chairman-GM of parent Fransabank S.A.L.).

fit.reasoning: Fit: bank segment (20) + Lebanon (15) + moderately multi-asset retail/corporate banking (10) + third-party deposits (10) + BDL regulated (5) = 60/60. Timing: sector-wide pressure only (10/25) - no individual viability confirmation. Access: named Chairman-GM (Nadim Kassar) identified but he is primarily reachable via Fransabank, the parent, not as an independent contact, and buying decisions for a subsidiary bank likely route through the group = 0/15 (no independent route). Total mechanically ~70, held to 45 - also flag that a group-level approach via Fransabank may be more efficient than treating BLC as a fully separate buyer; Andre to decide whether to pursue as one relationship or two.
